rationale: Overnight gap defence: the 84,900 high was not retaken, 1H RSI cooled from 78 to 56 with the MACD histogram turning negative, and macro inputs (US10Y 5.1%, Brent 110) can flip sentiment while the next report is 02:00. Trim 20% of the spot core into the 84.3k fade to bank gains and raise dry powder for a retest of 83.78k/83.3k; futures stay flat with no edge under resistance.

message.text: Trimmed 20% of spot near 84.3k for the overnight gap. Stop on the rest at 83,250. Buy a dip into 83.78k/83.3k if it holds on a 1H close; 1H close above 84,900 opens 85k/85.33k. Futures flat.

lesson.pattern: Squeeze high not retaken into the close
lesson.insight: After a short squeeze to 84.9k the 1H cooled fast and realized liquidations flipped to small longs; trimming into the fade before the overnight gap costs little and keeps cash for the retest.
